To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) PC12 cells express N-terminally-processed chromogranin-A, (2) this is immunoreactive to antisera to Vastatin I, Vastatin II fragment 2 and Vastatin II, fragment 1 and (3) this immunoreactivity is not due to cross-reactivity of these antibodies with other antigens.
the PC12 cell line expresses a 61-kDa protein that cross-reacts with antibodies to VST II fragment 3.
PC12 cells contain immunoreactivity to VST II and that this immunoreactivity cross-reacts with antisera to the N-terminal region of VST I and to VST II fragment 3.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the characterization of CGA and VST in PC12 cells.
the characterization of CGA and its fragments, vasostatin I and II in PC12 cells.
the characterization of the vasostatin-like peptides in rat PC12 cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
VST I, II, and fragment 3 are all present in PC12 cells and the 61-kDa species is the predominant form.
PC12 cells contain a number of CGA-derived peptides.
the PC12 cells express the CGA gene and that the N-terminal region of CGA is processed to yield a peptide with vasoinhibiting properties.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
VST I and II are present in PC12 cells and that VST II, 83-91, is present in higher amounts than VST II, fragments 1 and 2.
VST II fragment 3 is the most abundant form of CGA in PC 12 cells, and that it is present in the secretory vesicles.
VST is present in the PC12 cell, but not in a form that is recognized by antisera 875 and 875, and that VST II, fragments 2 and 3 are present.
The main takeaway from our work is that
VST I is not the only vasoinhibitory peptide in PC12 cells, and that VST II, fragments 3 and 2, are also vasoinhibitory peptides in these cells.
the VST I antiserum 874 cross-reacted with a protein with a molecular weight of 12 kDa, and the VST II, 876, antiserum cross-reacted with proteins with a molecular weight, 7. 2 and 12. kDa.
the N-terminus of CGA is processed in PC12 cells, and that VST II, fragments 2 and 3 are present.
